case_title: SYNERGETIC HEALTH CONSULTING CO VS DHL WORLD WIDE EXPRESS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY SYNERGETIC HEALTH CONSULTING CO AS TO DEFENDANT DHL WORLD WIDE EXPRESS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-19-1998 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SYNERGETIC HEALTH CONSULTING CO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DHL WORLD WIDE EXPRESS $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $20.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,020.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
